owned_invariants: The task is a dossier: grader, which must be cycle_duality, source_pins, an object, and cells, a nonempty list of cells with different cell_id values. A cell holds cell_id, input (a weighted digraph), raw_reply, raw_reply_sha256, input_sha256 and grade, all text but the input. A task that is not of this form is refused before anything is checked.

The host asks the model nothing. It records source_pin_matches (the dossier pins cycle_duality at the pin of the grader as it is now), stored_bytes_match_digests, every_grade_reproduces and zero_model_calls, in that order.

A reply and an input match their digests when raw_reply_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the reply text and input_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical form of the input. The cells that do not are named as cell_id:raw_reply or cell_id:input, in the order of the cells.
A grade reproduces when the stored reply, graded on the stored input, earns the stored grade. The cells that do not are listed by name in sorted order.

A pin that does not match is refused as SOURCE_PIN_DRIFT, and after that a digest that does not match as STORED_BYTES_DRIFTED with the cells that drifted. Otherwise a grade that does not reproduce is refused under every_grade_reproduces. All held, the replay is certified as REPLAY_REPRODUCED with the number of cells and no mismatches.
boundaries: A reproduced dossier says the stored bytes regrade to the stored grades under this grader. It does not say the replies were good, or that the run was ever made.
The pin ties a dossier to the text of the grader, so any edit of the grader refuses it.
A reply sent to a replay is not accepted: the run has no step to answer.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.

basis.G1: Module header declares AuthorityEffect None and the contract URN; public items match this contract and code/rust/pfp_operads/README.md. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond the README and docs/plans/operads_redesign.md.
basis.G2: Exact: digests are SHA-256 the tests rebuild themselves, the canonical form of an input is the host's, and every grade is the exact grader's. Not B: tested on examples, not proven; the hash library is trusted.
basis.G3: Each unreadable part of a task has its own reason, a drifted pin and drifted bytes are their own refusals, and a stored grade that does not reproduce is refused under its predicate. No panicking unwrap or expect, and no index. Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: 24 WF18 tests assert the registry entry, a dossier certified with each predicate and its evidence, a host that asks nothing and refuses a reply nobody asked for, a reply byte or an input that drifted and the cell it is named by, drift listed by cell with the reply before the input, a digest that is missing or not text, the digests as the hash of the reply text and of the canonical input, a grade that does not reproduce, the mismatches sorted, every kind of grade regraded, a parallel edge violation a grader might miss, a pin that refuses first and one that is missing or not text, pins of other graders ignored, each part of a dossier and of a cell read in order, and a dossier of one cell. Mutation campaign R = 77/77. clippy -D warnings and rustfmt pass. Not B: mutants are hand-written one-line edits, not a generated campaign, and there are no generator-driven property tests.
basis.G5: Measured worst cyclomatic 8, cognitive complexity is not measured for Rust, nesting 1; ceiling A+, recorded A.
